## Investigation

Does the observed baseline behaviour persist after a normal disconnect and
reconnection, without a vendor tool or network connection?

::: {.manual-prereq title="Require a recorded playable baseline"}

Confirm the previous MIDI/MPE and independent-sound records exist. Do not
change configuration before this test; this stage observes persistence of the
current state, rather than testing a newly chosen setting. Confirm that a normal
power-cycle is within the active specification's approved scope.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Capture before and after observations"}

Copy the template:

```bash
cp evidence/templates/power-cycle.yml evidence/records/seaboard-block-01-power-cycle.yml
```

Record the MIDI device name, port appearance, and fixed gesture results before
the power cycle. Disconnect normally, wait long enough for the device to power
down, reconnect by the same USB path, and repeat exactly the same observations.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Record only differences"}

Compare the two observations. Record changes in recognition, channel behaviour,
pitch response, pressure, or surface response. Do not infer a cause; label each
difference as observed, not observed, or unknown.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Evaluate persistence"}

Confirm baseline persistence only when the same documented observations recur
after reconnection. If they differ, report exactly what changed and preserve the
record for a later, focused investigation. Do not use Dashboard to repair the
state before documenting the failure.

:::
